title: Dynamic prompt corpus and weighted scenario sampler for profile generation
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Improve benchmark harness to produce richer, reproducible performance profiles by introducing a dynamic prompt corpus, weighted scenario sampling, and a lightweight eval-runner contract. Outputs will include lineage metadata and a standardized profile artifact that supports model version pinning and downstream publication to the model catalog.
acceptance_criteria: Dynamic prompt corpus ingestion tool that normalizes multiple sources (human prompts, replay logs, curated templates) and produces an annotated NDJSON corpus with tags, length buckets, and provenance metadata.
Weighted scenario sampler API that can sample by scenario weight, token-length distribution, and user-defined constraints, with deterministic seeding for reproducible runs.
Eval-runner plugin contract documented and implemented: standardized input/output, sidecar resource limits, per-request timeout, and retry/backoff behavior.

Profile artifact schema finalized: includes model_pin, model_version, dataset_hash, seed, per-scenario latency + p50/p95, throughput, token-accuracy metrics, and links to PRs and training/eval artifacts.
Automated publishing pipeline that validates profile artifact, signs it, and publishes to the model catalog with semantic versioning and rollback metadata.
CI smoke test that runs a small deterministic sample and asserts metrics within defined tolerances to detect regressions before publication.
comments: 2025-11-06 - Scoping: initial spike completed. Identified primary prompt sources: playground exports, replay clips (ingested via event pipeline), and curated templates from research. Decided corpus format = NDJSON with explicit provenance fields.

2025-11-09 - Design decision: use weighted sampling to better reflect production token-length and scenario distribution. Trade-off noted: higher cost for larger sample sets vs better representativeness; recommend configurable sample size per release tier.

2025-11-11 - Implementation: created sampler module and unit tests. Added deterministic seed parameter. Working on runner contract; prototype runner uses a sidecar process to isolate GPU memory and measure per-request KV cache warmup impact.

2025-11-13 - PRs opened: benchmarks#482 contains corpus ingestion and sampler; runtime#1257 contains small instrumentation for per-request timing. Need review from @sylvie, @martin. Next: add publishing hook and catalog integration tests.
